verdict.rationale: Activepieces' AI agent builder documents a human-in-the-loop gate where an agent's actions can wait for the user's approval before running, so the product does pause automated work for human sign-off. That evidence is only a marketing-level line scoped to agents, not flows. The Sensitive-project 'Request approval' feature governs publishing a flow, not pausing a running one, so it is adjacent and not credited. Missing for 10: a documented approval or wait step inside flows, collecting human input (forms or responses) mid-run, detail on how approvals are delivered and on timeouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pause a workflow to wait for human approval or input before it continues

citations.quote: It decides the steps and carries them out. Anything you want to check first waits for your approval.
